_README: Copy this file, rename it, edit the values. Run: python render_invoice.py data/<your-file>.json  ·  Totals are COMPUTED from the line items; the `expect` block below is a tripwire — if the two disagree the renderer refuses to emit a PDF.

doc.title: Pro Forma Invoice
doc._title_note: Use 'Invoice' and set is_final true once costs are confirmed and the document is payable.
doc.subtitle: Pokémon card evaluation, preparation and PSA grading services.

customer.name: Customer Name
customer._lines_note: Any extra identity lines under the name. Leave [] if you have none — never invent contact details.

rows._ties_to: 'evaluated' cross-checks qty against expect.evaluated_cards; 'cards' cross-checks it against the grading card count.

grading.label: PSA grading submission
grading.caption: N cards

cards.name: Card Name
cards._variant: optional blue chip (1st Edition / Prerelease / Holo)
cards._flag: optional orange chip — use on any card budgeted above the base fee

grading.footnote: Optional note under the table. Omit the key to hide it.

shipping._note: null renders 'TBD' and leaves it out of the total. Put a number here on the final invoice and it is added in.

summary.label: Financial summary

explain.heading: What this covers
explain.body: Sake Kitty Cards earns $0.00 of this invoice. The remaining $0.00 is a PSA grading charge, passed through at actual cost with no markup.

summary.grand_note: Before insured shipping and any PSA tier adjustments

points.text: Set flag true for an orange bullet.

notes.title: Grading estimates
notes.body: PSA charges are provisional. Service levels and declared values are confirmed before submission.

notes.title: Shipping
notes.body: Insured shipping is additional, at actual approved cost. Coverage is confirmed with you before anything ships.

notes.title: Additional PSA charges
notes.body: PSA may adjust service tiers or add charges on its own assessment. You get an updated breakdown if that happens.

notes.title: Grade expectations
notes.body: Our condition assessments are estimates. Final grades are determined independently by PSA. No grade or resale value is guaranteed.

notes.title: Submission coordination
notes.body: Complimentary with paid cleaning and preparation. No separate submission or handling fee. Preparation is non-invasive — no restoration or alteration of any card.

notes.title: Final authorization
notes.body: A final invoice and payment instructions follow once costs are confirmed. Nothing is authorized or shipped on the basis of this document.

layout._note: Each page lists the blocks it carries, in order. Available: masthead, conthead, docline, services, grading, summary, submission_notes, terms. render_invoice.py refuses to emit a PDF if any page overflows, so move a block to the next page if it complains.
